apps.name: Supabase
apps.description: Full self-hosted Supabase — Postgres, Auth, REST, Realtime, Storage, and Studio behind one API gateway.

configFields.label: Database password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. The password for the Postgres superuser and Supabase service roles.

configFields.label: JWT secret
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Signs the anon and service_role API keys and every user session.

configFields.label: Anon key
configFields.help: Auto-generated. The public API key for client-side (anonymous) requests.

configFields.label: Service role key
configFields.help: Auto-generated. The secret API key that bypasses row-level security — keep it private.

configFields.label: Realtime secret key base
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Signs the Realtime service's internal tokens.

configFields.label: Metadata crypto key
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Encrypts connection credentials stored by postgres-meta.

configFields.label: Studio password
configFields.help: Auto-generated. The password to sign in to Supabase Studio.

configFields.label: Studio username
configFields.help: The username to sign in to Supabase Studio.

files.content:
_format_version: "3.0"
_transform: true

consumers:
  - username: DASHBOARD
  - username: anon
    keyauth_credentials:
      - key: {{config:ANON_KEY}}
  - username: service_role
    keyauth_credentials:
      - key: {{config:SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}}

acls:
  - consumer: anon
    group: anon
  - consumer: service_role
    group: admin

basicauth_credentials:
  - consumer: DASHBOARD
    username: {{config:DASHBOARD_USERNAME}}
    password: {{config:DASHBOARD_PASSWORD}}

services:
  - name: auth-v1-open
    url: http://auth:9999/verify
    routes:
      - name: auth-v1-open
        strip_path: true
        paths:
          - /auth/v1/verify
    plugins:
      - name: cors
  - name: auth-v1-open-callback
    url: http://auth:9999/callback
    routes:
      - name: auth-v1-open-callback
        strip_path: true
        paths:
          - /auth/v1/callback
    plugins:
      - name: cors
  - name: auth-v1-open-authorize
    url: http://auth:9999/authorize
    routes:
      - name: auth-v1-open-authorize
        strip_path: true
        paths:
          - /auth/v1/authorize
    plugins:
      - name: cors
  - name: auth-v1
    url: http://auth:9999/
    routes:
      - name: auth-v1-all
        strip_path: true
        paths:
          - /auth/v1/
    plugins:
      - name: cors
      - name: key-auth
        config:
          hide_credentials: false
      - name: acl
        config:
          hide_groups_header: true
          allow:
            - admin
            - anon
  - name: rest-v1
    url: http://rest:3000/
    routes:
      - name: rest-v1-all
        strip_path: true
        paths:
          - /rest/v1/
    plugins:
      - name: cors
      - name: key-auth
        config:
          hide_credentials: true
      - name: acl
        config:
          hide_groups_header: true
          allow:
            - admin
            - anon
  - name: graphql-v1
    url: http://rest:3000/rpc/graphql
    routes:
      - name: graphql-v1-all
        strip_path: true
        paths:
          - /graphql/v1
    plugins:
      - name: cors
      - name: key-auth
        config:
          hide_credentials: true
      - name: request-transformer
        config:
          add:
            headers:
              - Content-Profile:graphql_public
      - name: acl
        config:
          hide_groups_header: true
          allow:
            - admin
            - anon
  - name: realtime-v1-ws
    url: http://realtime-dev.supabase-realtime:4000/socket/
    routes:
      - name: realtime-v1-ws
        strip_path: true
        paths:
          - /realtime/v1/
    plugins:
      - name: cors
      - name: key-auth
        config:
          hide_credentials: false
      - name: acl
        config:
          hide_groups_header: true
          allow:
            - admin
            - anon
  - name: storage-v1
    url: http://storage:5000/
    routes:
      - name: storage-v1-all
        strip_path: true
        paths:
          - /storage/v1/
    plugins:
      - name: cors
  - name: meta
    url: http://meta:8080/
    routes:
      - name: meta-all
        strip_path: true
        paths:
          - /pg/
    plugins:
      - name: key-auth
        config:
          hide_credentials: false
      - name: acl
        config:
          hide_groups_header: true
          allow:
            - admin
  - name: dashboard
    url: http://studio:3000/
    routes:
      - name: dashboard-all
        strip_path: true
        paths:
          - /
    plugins:
      - name: cors
      - name: basic-auth
        config:
          hide_credentials: true

connection.title: Connect to Supabase
connection.description: Point the Supabase client SDKs or Studio at this deployment. The service role key bypasses row-level security — keep it secret.

guide.intro: Your project gets the Supabase database connection, ready to use.
guide.useHint: Read `process.env.DATABASE_URL` in your code — it's set the next time your project deploys. Nothing else to do.

outputs.label: Studio
outputs.help: Open in a browser and sign in with the Studio username + password below.

outputs.label: Service role key
outputs.help: Full-access key — never expose it to browsers.

outputs.label: Database URL
outputs.help: Direct Postgres connection (superuser) reachable over this project's shared network. Connect another project to Supabase to inject it automatically.

apps.name: MinIO
apps.description: S3-compatible object storage with a web console — point any S3 client (aws-cli, SDKs) at it, or bind a bucket straight into another project's uploads.

configFields.label: Root user (access key)
configFields.help: The console + S3 admin username. Minimum 3 characters.

configFields.label: Root password (secret key)
configFields.help: Auto-generated. The S3 admin secret — shown once after install.

configFields.label: First bucket
configFields.help: Created on the first deploy so an app can use this storage immediately. More can be added from the console.

prepare.command: mc alias set local http://127.0.0.1:9000 "$MINIO_ROOT_USER" "$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD" > /dev/null && mc mb --ignore-existing "local/$OPENSHIP_BUCKET" > /dev/null && printf '%s' "$OPENSHIP_BUCKET"

connection.title: S3 connection
connection.description: Use these with any S3 client — the endpoint is the S3 API URL, the keys are the root user / password.

guide.intro: Your app gets an S3-compatible bucket it can write uploads to.
guide.useHint: Bind it from the consuming project's Configuration → Object storage to get the framework's own env names (Laravel gets FILESYSTEM_DISK + AWS_*), or wire these values by hand.
